title: plastic sandwich cutters
text: plastic sandwich cutters. These are plastic and sharp enough to cut fluffy bread... but not on much of the healthy stuff... I also tossed the puppy cutter - basically all you get is the puppy in the middle... ? Whats up with that? anyway... I use these to entice my 5 year old grandson to eat.  Sometimes it works!  I involve him in making the sandwich, cutting it and then putting it on the plate with other sides of his choice. I found that cutting the crusts off before cutting helps.  I have a very high top drawer in my dishwasher - so I do wash them in there, but regular top rack should work.  They do have sharp edges and they are brittle plastic so I imagine they will have a fairly short life time, maybe longer if you hand wash in all fairness.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
